g.text: A corpus of museum audio description

g.text: English-language descriptions of paintings, 1817–2024, collected from museum audio guides and accessibility programmes.

text.style: font-size: 8.8px; font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5c6470

g.text: Movement, painter and institution are deeply confounded by the way the material exists: Impressionism’s 88 descriptions come from 9 painters, non-geometric Abstraction’s 72 from 38. Movement effects are therefore estimated with crossed random intercepts for text, painter and institution.
